name: tail
description: Tail frame. REQUIRED, exactly once, last frame. See spec/sbtrace-v1.md §6.6.

fields.name: wallclock_ns
fields.description: Recorder wall-clock at trace close, ns since Unix epoch.

extension_ranges.description: Reserved for the SB-Trace spec. v1 keeps the tail body minimal; a v2 candidate adds a Merkle summary frame between the last step and the tail (see Step 52 of 100_STEPS.md).
Tail-side metadata contributed by registered capabilities (e.g. compact dirty-set summary).
